```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 13, fig.height = 8)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(furrr)
library(digest)
library(igraph)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
source(here::here("scripts/Network.R"))
dir.create(here::here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE)

N_WORKERS <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

run_cached <- function(cache_name, fn, hash_obj) {
  hash       <- digest::digest(hash_obj)
  cache_file <- here::here(paste0("data/", cache_name, "_cache.rds"))
  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cc <- readRDS(cache_file)
    if (identical(cc$hash, hash)) return(cc$data)
  }
  out <- fn()
  saveRDS(list(hash = hash, data = out), cache_file)
  out
}

metrics_core  <- c("n_direct_voters", "delegation_rate", "lost_vote_rate", "chain_length")
metric_labels <- c(n_direct_voters = "Number of direct voters", delegation_rate = "Delegation rate",
                    lost_vote_rate = "Lost-vote rate", chain_length = "Avg. chain length")

LAMBDA_TR <- 1 - 0.5^(1/5)   # half-life = 5 rounds
C_NEUTRAL <- 0.5             # neutral, not yet calibrated
MAX_ROUND <- 1000L
N_SEEDS   <- 10L
STEADY_WINDOW <- 5L
R_LOW  <- 2
R_HIGH <- 32
DELTA_TOL_SEM <- 0.5   # stability: |change| < 0.5 * SEM across seeds

r_settings <- tribble(
  ~r_label, ~r_op, ~r_pw, ~r_tr,
  "r0",     0,     0,     0,
  "r_low",  R_LOW, R_LOW, R_LOW,
  "r_high", R_HIGH,R_HIGH,R_HIGH
)

run_sim_cell <- function(seed, N, K, r_op, r_pw, r_tr, r_label) {
  res <- simulate_liquid_democracy(
    seed = seed, n_per_community = N, n_communities = 1, node_degree = K, T = MAX_ROUND,
    r_op = r_op, r_pw = r_pw, gamma = r_tr, lambda = LAMBDA_TR, k1 = 1, k2 = 1,
    decision_model = "calib", self_reliance_c = C_NEUTRAL, trust_mode = "relaxation",
    sigma_opinion = "auto", fast_path = TRUE, p_rewire = 0.05,
    snap_rounds = seq_len(MAX_ROUND)
  )
  tibble(seed = seed, N = N, K = K, r_label = r_label, round = seq_len(MAX_ROUND),
    delegation_rate = res$history_delegation,
    n_direct_voters = N * (1 - delegation_rate),
    lost_vote_rate  = res$history_lost,
    chain_length    = res$snapshots$avg_chain_length_delegators)
}

steady_summary <- function(raw_df, group_var) {
  raw_df |>
    filter(round > MAX_ROUND - STEADY_WINDOW) |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(metrics_core), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_var, "r_label", "metric"))), seed) |>
    summarise(steady_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_var, "r_label", "metric")))) |>
    summarise(mean_val = mean(steady_val), sem = sd(steady_val) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
}

stability_table <- function(steady_df, group_var) {
  steady_df |>
    arrange(metric, r_label, .data[[group_var]]) |>
    group_by(metric, r_label) |>
    mutate(delta = abs(mean_val - lag(mean_val)), stable = delta < DELTA_TOL_SEM * sem) |>
    ungroup()
}
```

# Model

$$A_{ij}=a^{tr}_{ij}\,a^{pw}_{ij}\,a^{op}_{ij}\quad(a^{ig}=1,\ r_{ig}=0\text{ -- Part I only})$$
$$a^{op}_{ij}=\exp(-r_{op}|o_i-o_j|)\in(0,1],\qquad a^{pw}_{ij}=2\mathcal L\!\left(r_{pw}\log\tfrac{p_j}{p_i}\right)\in(0,2),\qquad a^{tr}_{ij}=2\mathcal L\!\left(r_{tr}(\tau_{ij}-1)\right)\in(0,2)$$
$$\tau_{ij}(t)=(1-\lambda)\,\tau_{ij}(t-1)+\lambda\big(1+s_{ij}(t-1)\big),\quad \tau_{ij}(0)=1,\qquad s_{ij}(t-1)=\begin{cases}k_1\big(1-2|o_i-v_j(t-1)|\big) & j\text{ delivered}\\ -k_2 & j\text{'s vote lost to a cycle}\end{cases}$$
$$P_{\text{self}}(A_k)=\frac{M-A_k}{M+A_k\left(\frac{M-1}{c}-M\right)},\qquad M=4,\quad k_1=k_2=1$$

---

# Part 1: Choosing K at N = 1000

## Theoretical corridor

$N \gg K \gg \ln(N) \gg 1$; margin $K > 2\ln N$, $N > 10K$, $N=1000$:

```{r p1-corridor}
N_STEP1 <- 1000L
K_min <- floor(2 * log(N_STEP1)) + 1L
K_max <- as.integer(floor(N_STEP1 / 10)) - 1L
```

$K \in [`r K_min`, `r K_max`]$. Dunbar's social-layer framework provides a
qualitative reference point for a locally accessible neighbourhood
(sympathy group $\approx 15$), not a quantitative degree estimate.
Candidate set, chosen inside the corridor and around this reference:

dunbar_layers <- tibble::tribble(
  ~layer,              ~size, ~description,
  "Support clique",       5,  "Closest confidants (family, best friends)",
  "Sympathy group",      15,  "Close friends whose lives and views one knows well",
  "Affinity group",      50,  "Regular but less intimate contacts",
  "Active network",      150, "Stable social relationships (\"Dunbar's number\")",
  "Acquaintances",       500, "Broader circle of recognisable contacts",
  "Faces/Names",        1500, "Individuals recognised by sight or name"
)



```{r p1-grid}
k_grid <- c(16, 24, 32, 40, 48)
```

$K \in \{`r paste(k_grid, collapse=", ")`\}$.

## Small-world validation

```{r p1-smallworld}
compute_sw_stats <- function(K, n_reps = 30) {
  ws_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_reps), function(s) {
    st <- setup_agents(N_STEP1, 1, seed = s)
    gF <- setup_friendship_network(st$agents, 1, K, p_rewire = 0.05, seed = s)
    gU <- as.undirected(gF, mode = "collapse")
    tibble(clustering = transitivity(gU, type = "average"),
           path_len   = mean_distance(gU, directed = FALSE, unconnected = TRUE),
           n_comp     = components(gU)$no)
  })
  st0   <- setup_agents(N_STEP1, 1, seed = 1)
  g_lat <- setup_friendship_network(st0$agents, 1, K, p_rewire = 0, seed = 1) |> as.undirected(mode = "collapse")
  g_er  <- sample_gnm(N_STEP1, gsize(g_lat), directed = FALSE)
  tibble(K = K,
    ws_clustering = mean(ws_rows$clustering), ws_path = mean(ws_rows$path_len),
    ws_components_max = max(ws_rows$n_comp),
    lattice_clustering = transitivity(g_lat, type = "average"),
    lattice_path = mean_distance(g_lat, directed = FALSE, unconnected = TRUE),
    er_clustering = transitivity(g_er, type = "average"),
    er_path = mean_distance(g_er, directed = FALSE, unconnected = TRUE))
}

sw_stats <- run_cached("smallworld_validation_k", function() {
  purrr::map_dfr(k_grid, compute_sw_stats)
}, list(N_STEP1, k_grid, v = 1))

kable(sw_stats |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))),
      caption = "WS vs. lattice (`p_rewire`=0) vs. Erdos-Renyi. Small-world = clustering near lattice, path length near ER.")
```

## Model outcome stability across K

```{r p1-run}
grid_k <- tidyr::crossing(K = k_grid, seed = seq_len(N_SEEDS)) |>
  tidyr::crossing(r_settings |> select(r_label)) |>
  left_join(r_settings, by = "r_label")

k_raw <- run_cached("k_grid_raw", function() {
  plan(multisession, workers = N_WORKERS)
  out <- future_pmap_dfr(grid_k, function(K, seed, r_label, r_op, r_pw, r_tr)
    run_sim_cell(seed, N_STEP1, K, r_op, r_pw, r_tr, r_label), .options = furrr_options(seed = NULL))
  plan(sequential)
  out
}, list(MAX_ROUND, N_SEEDS, k_grid, r_settings, N_STEP1, LAMBDA_TR, v = 1))

k_steady <- steady_summary(k_raw, "K")
```

```{r p1-plot, fig.height=14}
k_steady |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric_labels[metric], levels = unname(metric_labels)),
         r_label = factor(r_label, levels = c("r0", "r_low", "r_high"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(K, mean_val)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue4", linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - sem, ymax = mean_val + sem), width = 1) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ r_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Steady-state outcomes vs. K", x = "K", y = NULL)
```

## Decision: K

$K^*$ = smallest $K$ for which a further increase changes each metric by
less than $`r DELTA_TOL_SEM`\times\text{SEM}$, at every $r$-setting.

```{r p1-decision}
kable(stability_table(k_steady, "K") |> filter(!is.na(delta)) |>
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))),
      caption = "Step-to-step change vs. SEM-based tolerance, per metric x r-setting")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PICK K: smallest K after which `stable` holds for all metric x
# r_label combinations at every subsequent K. Inspect table above.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CHOSEN_K <- 32L
```

**Chosen: K = `r CHOSEN_K`.**

---

# Part 2: Confirming N = 1000 at K = `r CHOSEN_K`

$N=1000$ was fixed pragmatically before Part 1. This checks it is large
enough that outcomes no longer depend on further increases in $N$, holding
$K=`r CHOSEN_K`$ fixed.

```{r p2-grid}
n_grid <- c(500, 750, 1000, 1500, 2000)

corridor_n <- tibble(N = n_grid) |>
  mutate(K_over_lnN = round(CHOSEN_K / log(N), 2), N_over_K = round(N / CHOSEN_K, 2))
kable(corridor_n, caption = sprintf("K=%d relative to each candidate N -- confirms all pairs stay inside the small-world margin", CHOSEN_K))
```

```{r p2-run}
grid_n <- tidyr::crossing(N = n_grid, seed = seq_len(N_SEEDS)) |>
  tidyr::crossing(r_settings |> select(r_label)) |>
  left_join(r_settings, by = "r_label")

n_raw <- run_cached("n_sensitivity_raw", function() {
  plan(multisession, workers = N_WORKERS)
  out <- future_pmap_dfr(grid_n, function(N, seed, r_label, r_op, r_pw, r_tr)
    run_sim_cell(seed, N, CHOSEN_K, r_op, r_pw, r_tr, r_label), .options = furrr_options(seed = NULL))
  plan(sequential)
  out
}, list(MAX_ROUND, N_SEEDS, n_grid, r_settings, CHOSEN_K, LAMBDA_TR, v = 1))

n_steady <- steady_summary(n_raw, "N")
```

```{r p2-plot, fig.height=14}
n_steady |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric_labels[metric], levels = unname(metric_labels)),
         r_label = factor(r_label, levels = c("r0", "r_low", "r_high"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(N, mean_val)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue4", linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - sem, ymax = mean_val + sem), width = 20) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ r_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Steady-state outcomes vs. N", x = "N", y = NULL)
```

## Decision: N

```{r p2-decision}
kable(stability_table(n_steady, "N") |> filter(!is.na(delta)) |>
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))),
      caption = "Step-to-step change vs. SEM-based tolerance, per metric x r-setting")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CONFIRM N: `stable` must hold from N=1000 onward for all metric x
# r_label combinations. If not, move up to the next N for which it does.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CHOSEN_N <- 1000L
```

**Chosen: N = `r CHOSEN_N`, K = `r CHOSEN_K`.**
